_doc: SR-CHURN-CUT 3 (2026-10-19). Every machine-owned path: CI regenerates it from main and a PR never carries it (generated_paths.py check; ci_generated.py generate --base). `paths` are exact files, `prefixes` the generated trees minus `not_generated_prefixes` (governed receipts, not compiler output). The cockpit's patch-id computation (SR-CHURN-CUT 4) excludes these with `generated_paths.py filter`. Kept equal to ci_generated.OUTPUTS plus `derived` by test_generated_paths.py. `hand_authored_hotspots` are files many open PRs touch that are NOT generated and must stay hand-authored (measured 2026-10-19 over refs/remotes/origin/kalayantra/* touched in the last 2 days).

derived.mechanism: ci_generated overlay (A5 D-33): generated-artifacts job computes it from the PR/queue source, restore-generated overlays it in every job; the committed copy on main is refreshed by `generated_paths.py refresh` (cockpit), never by a feature PR

hand_authored_hotspots.why: the plan model itself: source of CLOSURE_v3.json, not derivable
the fixed-operation table the executor reads from main: source of truth, hand-reviewed per kind
independent oracle for the table: a pin regenerated from the table would be a tautology (N.8); new reviewed edits go in append-only executor_pin_shards/ instead of this file
suite globs, hand-authored; conflict cut is a separate item (per-suite files)
